cover.concept: A glowing orange map-pin shape hovering above a row of round indigo button shapes, with one slot in the row left empty as a faint dashed outline; a thin line drops from that empty slot into blank space, suggesting a path that leads nowhere.

inline.name: empty-field
inline.concept: A row of three solid round buttons in muted indigo with a fourth slot left as an empty dashed outline, and a single thin line running out of that empty slot into open negative space, like a signal with nowhere to land.

inline.name: click-path
inline.concept: One bright accent-orange line running from a map-pin shape straight through a simple doorway shape into a softly lit rectangle, while several faint grey lines drift off in other directions and fade out.
